eyebrow: The first wall: your own quota
code:
# Azure: check current GPU quota in a region
az vm list-usage --location eastus \
  --query "[?contains(name.value, 'StandardNCADSA100v4Family')]"

# AWS: check a Service Quotas request for a GPU family
aws service-quotas get-service-quota \
  --service-code ec2 \
  --quota-code L-417A185B
caption: Raising a quota is a request, not a guarantee the physical hardware is sitting there.

code:
# Azure: On-Demand Capacity Reservation (illustrative)
az capacity reservation group create \
  --name gpu-train-q1 --location eastus
az capacity reservation create \
  --sku Standard_NC96ads_A100_v4 --capacity 8

# AWS: Capacity Block for ML (illustrative)
aws ec2 purchase-capacity-block \
  --capacity-block-offering-id cbo-example
caption: Reservations pay for held capacity in exchange for a provider-backed availability guarantee.
